mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO credit_score ( user_id, current_score, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{initialScore}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT credit_score_id, user_id, current_score, created_at, updated_at FROM credit_score WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE credit_score SET current_score = LEAST(#{maxScore}, GREATEST(#{minScore}, current_score + #{delta})), updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
